sql.settings: SELECT setting_key, setting_value FROM n_moderation_settings WHERE setting_key IN ('allow_moderator_claim', 'require_note_on_reject')
sql.post: SELECT post_id FROM n_posts WHERE post_id = :post_id FOR UPDATE
sql.case: SELECT case_id, assigned_to FROM n_moderation_cases WHERE target_type = 'post' AND target_id = :post_id FOR UPDATE
sql.updatePost: UPDATE n_posts SET is_deleted = :deleted, deleted_at = CASE WHEN :deleted = 1 THEN COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = :post_id
sql.updateCase: UPDATE n_moderation_cases SET status = :status, assigned_to = CASE WHEN :action = 'claim' THEN :viewer_id WHEN :action = 'release' THEN NULL ELSE assigned_to END, resolved_at = CASE WHEN :status IN ('approved','rejected','removed','restored') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE case_id = :case_id
sql.updateReports: UPDATE n_moderation_reports SET status = :status, handled_by = :viewer_id, resolved_at = CASE WHEN :status IN ('resolved','dismissed') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target_type = 'post' AND target_id = :post_id
